vignette: A 50-year-old woman has numbness of the little finger, wasting of the hand muscles and numbness of the medial forearm up to the elbow. The nerve conduction study shows an absent medial antebrachial cutaneous sensory response.

options.text: Lower trunk or medial cord of the brachial plexus
Median nerve at the carpal tunnel

explanation: The ulnar nerve supplies no forearm skin; numbness of the medial forearm with an absent medial antebrachial cutaneous potential proves the lesion is in the medial cord or lower trunk (thoracic outlet syndrome, Pancoast tumor, Klumpke injury), not at the elbow.
